LOCAL COUNCILS PROVINCIAL UNIFIED GROUP OF FUNCTIONARIES (EMPLOYEES ON
CONTRACT BASIS) (REGULATION OF SERVICES) RULES, 1990
LOCAL COUNCILS PROVINCIAL UNIFIED GROUP OF FUNCTIONARIES
(EMPLOYEES ON CONTRACT BASIS) (REGULATION OF SERVICES) RULES, 1990
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 1st April, 1990]
No.AO-IV/ICB/a-5/86, dated 1-4-1990.-----In exercise of the powers
conferred by section 172 of the North-West Frontier Province Local Government
Ordinance, 1979 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. IV of 1979), read with section 46 thereof, the
Government of the North-West Frontier Province is pleased to make the following
rules, namely:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) These rules may be called
the Local Councils Provincial Unified Group of Functionaries (Employees on
Contract Basis) (Regulation of Services) Rules, 1990.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
Definitions.--to these rules, unless the context otherwise
requires;--
(a) "Board" means the Board constituted under section 46
of the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 1979 (N.-W.F.P.
Ord. IV of 1979);
(b) "High Selection Committee" means the High Selection
Committee constituted vide Government Notification No.SO(LG-I)2-8/86, dated the
9th March, 1988; and
(c) "Post" means a post covered by clause (a) of
sub-rule (3) of rule 9 of the Local Councils (Provincial Unified Group of
Functionaries) Service. Rules, 1981.
3. Special provisions regarding employees on contract basis.--(1)
All persons appointed on contract basis to any post during the period from the
24th April, 1988, till the commencement of these rules and continuing as such,
shall, with immediate effect, be deemed to have been appointed on regular basis
subject to eligibility, according to the service rules applicable to the post,
verified by the Chairman, Local Council Board:
Provided that if a person coveted by this rule is not considered
eligible for regular appointment he shall have a right of appeal to the
Secretary to Government of North-West Frontier Province, Local Government and
Rural Development Department, whose decision in the case shall be final.
(2) The inter se seniority of the persons whose services are
regularised under these rules shall be determined by the Board, according to
the service rules in vogue.
4. Repeal.--Rule 5 of
the North-West Frontier Province Local Councils (PUGF) (Regularization of
Services) Rules, 1988, is hereby repealed.
